input_narrative: SYNTHETIC NARRATIVE: Synthetic remote monitoring center reported that the device failed to flag a clinically significant complete atrioventricular block episode in real time. A retrospective clinician review confirms a single missed, sustained complete atrioventricular block episode that self-resolved with no recorded adverse outcome; no second occurrence has yet been confirmed. The device's own confidence-score log and the clinician's retrospective read disagree on episode duration, an unresolved discrepancy.

evidence_links.relevance_note: This incident report confirms a life-threatening complete atrioventricular block event, which reached a patient but was not deployed to the clinical environment.
EU MDR Article 83(1)-(2) requires manufacturers to establish and maintain a post-market surveillance system. The missed episode may trigger obligations under this regulation.

EU MDR Annex I, Chapter II, Section 17.4 requires manufacturers to set out minimum requirements concerning hardware and IT security measures. The missed episode may trigger obligations under this regulation.
